prompt: What does the AI wiki have on RAG and vector databases? Give me the relevant pages.

assertions.text: References the core [[rag]] concept page as a wikilink
References at least one vector-database entity page (e.g. [[pgvector]], [[pinecone]], or [[faiss]])
Returns results grouped by category (e.g. Concepts/Entities, Topics, Sources, Analyses)
Cites at least one source page (a wiki/sources/ page) as a wikilink
Uses Obsidian base:query and/or tag/search CLI commands rather than reading wiki/index.md wholesale
